successors.name: Songze culture
successors.text: the Lake Tai country: "primarily around Lake Tai west of modern Shanghai", "the Yangtze River Delta", "southern Jiangsu and Zhejiang north of Hangzhou Bay" (Weidun at Changzhou, Songze at Qingpu in…

ledger.x: 5000 BCE: the Majiabang culture takes shape around Lake Tai and the Yangtze delta: "Dates: 5000-3350 BC", "from around 5000 BC to 3300 BC".
3800 BCE: the Majiabang tradition continues as the Songze culture (Songze "existed between 3800 and 3300 BCE... accepted to be the successor of the Majiabang culture").

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the Hangzhou Bay and the Yangtze are the natural edges.
